## 💥 THE ONLY ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE WHERE AN UNSTABLE COCKTAIL SAVES YOUR LIFE!

A brutal plague wiped out civilization, but you have a secret weapon: volatile survival serums! In Drunk Or Dead 2, keep the virus at bay by maintaining a special antidote level in your blood. Grab friends, load heavy calibers, and dive into a mad VR adventure where you balance on the edge of total madness and perfect accuracy!

[media]

## 🎒 SEASON 1: TO THE SUPERMARKET
Every survivor has a story. This is the first one — a complete, standalone episodic VR adventure packed with action and chaotic fun! Help Triss find new allies and smash your way through mutants to the ultimate final destination: the Supermarket! 

### 🔥 KEY FEATURES:
* **Unstable Stimulant System:** Gulp down volatile serums in battle. They trigger powerful combo effects and slow motion, but distort perception. Can you handle it when the floor starts spinning?
* **Smart Neuro Zombies:** Fight infected military squads that use cover, flank your team, and lay down heavy suppressive fire. Tactical zombies? Yes!
* **Smash the Horde:** Get behind the wheel of post-apocalyptic vehicles and turn monsters into mincemeat together with your squad.
* **Endless Horde Mode:** Test your limits on special arenas, holding the line against scaling waves of enemies.

---
*⚠️ Note: Season 1 story is fully complete at the Supermarket checkpoint. Season 2 is in development and will be available later as a DLC!*
